It’s time for an all-access tour of the Pagani factory! 

Mat’s over in Modena, Italy, and he’s about to see just what goes into creating some of the rarest and most expensive cars in the world! 

First up, he’s going to see what led Horacio Pagani to where he is today, with a trip to the Pagani museum. He’ll look over some of his first creations, including a bike and a Formula 2 car, while also getting up close with some of the first Paganis ever created.
